milestone: 2C lexical retrieval forensics and dev-only optimisation (EXPERIMENTAL; not an official ARB score)
data: Milestone 2B DEVELOPMENT repositories only (previously used development data); 2B held-out repositories excluded
framework: Phase 1 product-aligned evaluation: whole-file input, file unit, full ranking

variant_semantics.query_tf: multiply each query term's BM25 contribution by its query count (ARB BM25 behaviour)
variant_semantics.dedupe: emit each token at most once per source word (current tokenizer emits plain words twice: raw form and identical piece)
variant_semantics.json_values_only: if the query parses as a JSON object, score only its leaf values (key names dropped); otherwise unchanged

stage1_rule: Lexical-only, dev. A variant is a hybrid candidate if its dev mean (variant - L0) comment2context Recall@20 is > 0 and its dev mean for MRR and Recall@20 of every task is >= -0.02. At most the 3 candidates with the largest comment2context Recall@20 gain go to stage 2, plus 'C_combined' = all candidates applied together when >= 2 qualify.
stage2_rule: Full hybrid, dev. Select the arm with the largest dev mean comment2context Recall@20 gain over the hybrid baseline among arms whose dev mean MRR and Recall@20 for every task (and comment2context MRR) is >= -0.02. The selection is 'dev-supported' only if its repository-clustered 95% CI for comment2context Recall@20 excludes zero (positive). If no arm is dev-supported, no default change is made; any implementation stays opt-in.
confirmatory_requirement: Fresh repositories disjoint from all 25 ARB v2 repositories, independently labelled, covering all four tasks, split at repository level with a recorded hash, protocol registered before treatment results. If unavailable: no confirmatory claim (INCONCLUSIVE).
